May be useful adjunct to mood stabilizers for bipolar depression
May be useful in treating sleepiness associated with opioid
analgesia, particularly in end-of-life management
Subjective sensation associated with modafinil is usually one of
normal wakefulness, not of stimulation, although jitteriness can
rarely occur
Anecdotally, some patients may experience wearing off of efficacy
over time, especially for off-label uses, with restoration of efficacy
Compared to stimulants, modafinil has a novel mechanism of
action, novel therapeutic uses, and less abuse potential, but is often
inaccurately classified as a stimulant
